description: This file implements the UniformIntegerDistribution class, which models a discrete uniform distribution over a specified range of integers. It provides methods for calculating probability, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and sampling within the range.

classes.name: UniformIntegerDistribution
classes.description: Implements a discrete uniform distribution with methods for probability calculations, statistical measures, and sampling.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of a specific integer value within the distribution.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative probability up to a specified integer.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, calculated as the average of bounds.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution based on range length.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is continuous.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random integer within the distribution's range.
